challenges.why: It's easy to assume people will reach out if they need something. Most won't. Being the one who checks in first means more than people usually say.
challenges.challenge_text: Check in on someone you haven't talked to in a while, just a simple "thinking of you, how are you doing?"
Leave a genuinely kind review or comment for a local business you appreciate.
challenges.why: Small businesses live and die by word of mouth. Two minutes of your time can genuinely make someone's week and it costs you nothing.
